note: Four instruments to show the shape; confidence `recalled` throughout — written from knowledge with a citation, nothing opened.

instruments.title: Plan Maroc Vert
instruments.citation: Ministère de l'Agriculture, Plan Maroc Vert, launched at the Meknès agricultural fair, April 2008
instruments.summary: The 2008–2020 agricultural strategy: high-value export crops (citrus, olives, early vegetables) under 'Pillar I', smallholder support under 'Pillar II', and a national programme to convert irrigation to drip. Olive plantings roughly doubled over its life.

instruments.title: Water law 36-15
instruments.citation: Loi n° 36-15 relative à l'eau, promulgated by Dahir n° 1-16-113 of 10 August 2016 (BO n° 6506)
instruments.summary: Replaces the 1995 water law: basin agencies (ABH) as the planning unit, participatory management, desalination and reuse recognised, groundwater contracts.

instruments.title: National drinking-water and irrigation supply programme 2020–2027
instruments.citation: Programme National d'Approvisionnement en Eau Potable et d'Irrigation 2020–2027, agreement signed before the King, 13 January 2020 (≈115 bn MAD)
instruments.summary: Dams, inter-basin transfers, desalination (Agadir, Casablanca), reuse and irrigation modernisation, launched as the 2018–2022 drought deepened.

instruments.title: Génération Green 2020–2030
instruments.summary: Successor to Plan Maroc Vert: a rural middle class, digital agriculture, water efficiency and soil as the stated priorities.
